fe-design-archetype.detail: Re-judged at source commit 1ec2bf03249c by opening evidence/screenshots/az-planting-calendar-1280-light.png regenerated by this gate run and reading it, against Option 3 'Timeline + rail' as chosen in az-planting-calendar/design-refs/home-options/DECISION.md line 13. Three structural claims hold as written: the horizontal half-month timeline is the hero under the heading 'Half-month timeline', rendering a count chip per half-month with Aug 1 selected and marked NOW; crop rows are secondary beneath it under 'Plantable in Aug 1', 7 crops each with image, method badge, days-to-harvest and a cited source link; the planting assistant is a docked desktop right rail rather than a floating button. DEVIATION, carried forward rather than dropped: the zone IS a full-width bar ('Planning zone (Maricopa County low desert)') but it sits BELOW the crop search, not above it -- search is in the sticky top chrome. DECISION.md line 9 lists search placement as a separable piece with 'sticky chrome' among its sanctioned options, so the page still matches the chosen archetype. Judged from the rendered screenshot, not from component source. Per-half-month counts are not restated: the image was reviewed downscaled and single digits are not reliably legible at that size.
